predictions.current_behavior: The readout can trust report-level build_check and acceptance_eligible even when durable checkpoint records are ungated or carry the wrong schema.
predictions.expected_fix: The checkpoint aggregate derives and binds build_check plus acceptance_eligible, and the readout rejects every checkpoint record whose schema is not exact.
predictions.required_regression: Missing, skipped, or mismatched per-record build gates and schemas cannot produce a final PASS.

predictions.current_behavior: The merge reader can truncate or append to source checkpoint evidence while aggregating it.
predictions.expected_fix: Only the explicit single-writer resume path may repair a torn tail; merge reads never mutate source bytes.
predictions.required_regression: Read-only merge preserves hashes, and a torn final write fails clearly without modification.

predictions.current_behavior: A present invalid wilson95_rate can be accepted by the producer through a valid count fallback and rejected only by the readout.
predictions.expected_fix: A present wilson95_rate must itself be valid at producer, schema, and readout seams; count fallback applies only when it is absent.
predictions.required_regression: An out-of-range direct interval plus a valid normalized count interval is rejected before manifest production.

predictions.current_behavior: Search-crate pyproject.toml and build.rs are not fingerprinted, while generated target manifests can enter the fingerprint.
predictions.expected_fix: Hash checked build.rs and pyproject.toml inputs for both native trees, exclude target and repository metadata, and invalidate their mtimes without walking generated target files.
predictions.required_regression: Changing a checked build script or maturin feature config changes the fingerprint; changing target/package metadata does not.

predictions.current_behavior: The c20 prediction artifact phrases future verification outcomes as completed facts.
predictions.expected_fix: Prediction artifacts describe a verification plan; measured outcomes remain in PR evidence and reviewer reports.
predictions.required_regression: No prediction artifact added in this wave pre-claims PASS.

verification_plan.focused_tests: Run all certification, checkpoint, build-stamp, provenance, and public-invariant tests.
verification_plan.build: Perform a fresh two-consumer build because the fingerprint input set changes.
verification_plan.review: Require a fresh independent adversarial PASS.
